name: Veridical
author: eddie_dodd
description: Five modulation effects that do what their labels say.

modules.name: Chorus
modules.description: Stereo chorus with two, three or four voices.

modules.name: Phaser
modules.description: Stereo phaser with four, six or eight allpass stages.

modules.name: Ring Mod
modules.description: Stereo ring modulator with an internal sine carrier.

modules.name: Env Follower
modules.description: Stereo envelope follower with gate outputs.
